asserts: Human prose stays silent. This is the false-positive guard: if a change to the rule tables makes this case fail, the change is wrong.
Every phrase family fires: inflation, promo, parallelism, disclaimer, connective, vocab, copula, attribution, hook, summary, merism.
Chat artifacts, cutoff self-reference, tracking parameters, and placeholders all report as DEBRIS and force exit 2.
--allow cannot silence DEBRIS. Output and exit code match the un-allowed run exactly.
A well-formed procedure is clean under docs. Uniform paragraphs and steady sentence length are correct here and must not be reported.
The same file under blog reports the structure notes that docs suppresses. Proves CHANNEL_SUPPRESS is doing the work rather than the rules being dead.
Dialogue with interrupting em dashes is clean under creative.
The same scene under blog flags the em dashes. Same proof in the other direction.
Each nominalization and wordiness pattern fires once, on its own line.
The three real stacks fire. The six ordinary sentences below them, including the verb phrases that earlier versions of the rule misread as stacks, stay silent.
